guiseley.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of Aireborough
s1loc: Guiseley runs a lively calendar across Aireborough. Guiseley Theatre on The Green, home of the Guiseley Amateur Operatic Society and its Barney Colehan Hall, stages drama, comedy and music, while the Guiseley Sounds Festival fills Nethermoor Park with two stages of live music each May. The Aireborough Beer Festival takes over the theatre, and nearby Yeadon Town Hall Theatre and the Tarnfield Park lawns at Yeadon Tarn keep the wider events calendar busy through the year.

And the trade runs at every size here. Major venues, festival operators and production companies across the Leeds fringe field large seasonal crews and buy through procurement, while independent event crews, promoters and entertainers around Guiseley and Yeadon need just a few branded pieces. A workwear supplier has to serve the big park festival and the single crew alike, which is why we run trade accounts and direct online ordering side by side.

The deeper trade sits with the people who build the shows. Staging and marquee contractors, PA and lighting hire firms, stewarding teams and funfair operators work the Nethermoor and Tarnfield grounds, the operatic and dramatic societies rehearse and perform season after season, and parish galas and church-hall productions run their own dates across Pudsey and the wider Aireborough belt.
